meta.name: cash-flow-forecast
meta.description: Forecast cash flow and runway for a Well workspace from booked invoices and collected bank transactions. Use when the user asks for a cash-flow forecast, runway, how long until they run out of cash, projected balance, or expected inflows/outflows.

copy.tagline: 根据发票和银行交易预测现金流和资金跑道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要根据实际交易数据预测公司未来现金流
copy.tagline_en: Forecast cash flow and runway from invoices and bank transactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict future cash flow based on actual invoices and bank transactions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据已开票的发票和银行交易记录，预测现金流和资金存续期。它按实际数据（发票、收款、付款天数）逐期展示预计余额，并告知资金还能维持多久。
howto.when: 当用户询问现金流预测、资金存续期、预计余额、预期收入或支出时触发。

say.text: 帮我预测未来三个月的现金流。
say.note: 会给出逐期余额和跑道。
基于现有发票和交易数据。

say.text: 展示下周的现金流预测。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can forecast cash flow and runway based on booked invoices and collected bank transactions. It projects balance per period using actual data (invoices, payments, days-to-pay) and tells how long funds will last.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a cash-flow forecast, runway, projected balance, expected inflows/outflows, or how long until cash runs out.

say_en.text: Forecast cash flow for the next three months.

say_en.note: Based on existing invoices and transactions.

say_en.text: Show cash flow for next week.
